title: The Probabilistic Tsetlin Machine: A Novel Approach to Uncertainty Quantification
venue: 8th International Conference on Advances in Artificial Intelligence 2024, ACM (author version on arXiv)
new_feature: Probabilistic Tsetlin Machine (PTM): instead of a single TA state, each TA keeps a probability vector over its states, updated via transition-probability matrices derived from Type I/II feedback; at inference states are sampled (BNN-like) to give predictive mean, entropy and mutual information for uncertainty quantification.

datasets.notes: variant of Granmo (2018) Noisy XOR with redundant features eliminated and 30% random inversion of outputs; PTM with 4 clauses; only qualitative SSP plots (Figs 1-2)

datasets.split_as_reported: 1000 labeled training examples; 2000 unlabeled test points spread over a larger range than training data
datasets.notes: generator not specified; only qualitative results (Fig. 3 predictive mean/entropy/std surfaces, 100 prediction samples)
Fig. 5 shows predictive entropy and mutual information histograms (qualitative)
